* Develop controls to mitigate prompt injection, jailbreaks, data leakage, hallucinations, model abuse, and adversarial attacks.
* Define AI trust, safety, governance, and security standards.
* Evaluate AI applications against organizational security, privacy, and compliance requirements.
* Establish policies and enforcement mechanisms for responsible AI usage.
* Conduct security architecture reviews for AI applications, agents, and autonomous workflows.
* Define secure deployment patterns for LLM, RAG, and agent\-based solutions.
* Establish security logging, monitoring, and detection capabilities for AI systems.


 AI Red Teaming
   

  

* Conduct AI red team assessments against enterprise AI applications.
* Develop adversarial testing scenarios and attack simulations.
* Identify and document vulnerabilities and weaknesses within AI systems.
* Perform threat modeling for AI\-enabled business processes.
* Define remediation recommendations and compensating controls.
* Perform AI\-focused penetration testing against LLM, RAG, and agentic applications.
* Assess risks related to prompt injection, indirect prompt injection, tool manipulation, excessive agency, data poisoning, and model abuse.
* Execute threat\-informed adversarial simulations aligned to MITRE ATLAS and OWASP LLM guidance.


 Engineering \& Automation
   

  

* Develop Python\-based automation for AI security and testing workflows.
* Build APIs, integrations, and orchestration frameworks supporting AI evaluation efforts.
* Integrate testing and governance controls into CI/CD pipelines.
* Create dashboards and reporting capabilities that provide visibility into AI risk and performance.
* Integrate AI security controls into DevSecOps and Secure SDLC processes.
* Automate security validation, compliance verification, and security regression testing for AI applications.

* Application Security (OWASP Top 10\)
* Secure SDLC / DevSecOps
* Penetration Testing and Red Teaming
* Security Architecture Reviews
* Cloud Security
* Identity and Access Management
* Threat Detection and Monitoring
* Vulnerability Management


 Additional Security Frameworks
   

  

* MITRE ATLAS
* OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
* OWASP ASVS
* NIST AI Risk Management Framework
* NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF)
* Secure AI Development and Governance Frameworks

* BE / BTech / MTech / MSc / MCA


**Experience**
* 4–8 years in Cybersecurity
* 2\+ years working with AI/ML or Security Automation initiatives
* Experience leading enterprise Vulnerability Management programs


**Preferred Certifications**

* Building AI\-enabled cyber defense solutions.
* Automating vulnerability and risk management processes.
* Driving next\-generation cyber transformation initiatives.


 The ideal candidate combines the mindset of a Security Architect, Vulnerability Management Leader and AI Engineer to create intelligent, scalable, and resilient cybersecurity VM programs.

title: Senior Computer Scientist - C++
description:
**The Opportunity**
 Adobe builds products that power millions of customer experiences worldwide. Behind these products are sophisticated software systems operating at scale, where
 **performance, reliability, security, and engineering excellence** 
 are fundamental requirements.
   

  

 We are looking for a
 **Senior Computer Scientist with deep C\+\+ expertise** 
 who enjoys solving complex technical problems and taking ownership of significant areas of the product. You will shape architecture, build high\-performance software, make critical technical decisions, and influence solutions that span components and teams.
   

  

 We value engineers who are
 **self\-driven, proactive, and outcome\-oriented** 
 — engineers who challenge assumptions, solve problems at their root, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and take responsibility for making the systems they own better, more reliable, and easier to evolve.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Own and evolve significant technical areas end\-to\-end — from understanding ambiguous problems and defining the right solution through architecture, implementation, production validation, and long\-term evolution.
* Design and build high\-performance C\+\+ systems, making thoughtful decisions around architecture, concurrency, memory management, resource utilization, and scalability.
* Drive technical direction for complex problems — evaluate alternatives, make pragmatic tradeoffs, and influence architecture decisions across components and teams.
* Solve problems at the root — identify systemic causes rather than treating symptoms, and drive durable solutions that reduce recurring issues and technical debt.
* Own outcomes, not just tasks — proactively identify gaps, risks, and opportunities and drive them to closure with minimal direction.
* Solve complex problems across boundaries, collaborating with engineers, architects, product managers, and other teams to deliver cohesive solutions.
* Raise the engineering bar through architecture and code reviews, performance optimization, testing, and engineering best practices.
* Build for operational excellence with strong focus on performance, reliability, security, observability, maintainability, and efficient resource utilization.
* Be a force multiplier — mentor engineers, share technical expertise, and establish patterns and practices that improve the broader engineering organization.
* Leverage AI\-assisted engineering to accelerate development and problem solving, improve engineering workflows, and increase team productivity.


**What You Need To Succeed**
* B.Tech/M.Tech in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of hands\-on software engineering experience, with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex technical solutions.
* Deep expertise in C\+\+, including modern C\+\+, memory management, concurrency, multithreading, STL, and performance optimization.
* Strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, operating systems, and computer science fundamentals.
* Strong understanding of systems design, distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and performance engineering.
* Experience designing and building large\-scale, high\-performance software systems.
* Experience building or operating Distributed systems at scale, with an understanding of multi\-tenancy, scaling, reliability, backward compatibility, security, observability, and capacity planning.
* Strong experience with performance analysis and optimization, including profiling CPU, memory, I/O, latency, and resource utilization.
* Experience with cloud platforms, distributed infrastructure, and modern software development practices.
* Strong proficiency in AI\-assisted engineering, leveraging tools such as Claude, Codex, or Copilot to accelerate development, improve problem solving, and enhance engineering productivity.
* Strong technical judgment and problem\-solving ability, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and influence technical decisions across teams.


**What Success Looks Like**
 Success in this role is not measured only by the features you deliver. You will be successful when you:
   

  

* Own and evolve significant technical areas with minimal direction and strong technical judgment.
* Turn ambiguous, complex problems into clear technical direction and executable solutions.
* Make architecture decisions that balance performance, scalability, reliability, maintainability, and long\-term evolution.
* Solve systemic problems at their root and eliminate recurring sources of complexity, performance issues, and operational risk.
* Influence technical direction across teams and organizational boundaries through technical depth and credibility.
* Deliver solutions that materially improve performance, scalability, reliability, quality, or developer productivity.
* Raise the technical bar through mentorship, design leadership, and engineering practices that benefit the broader organization.


**About Adobe**
 Adobe empowers everyone to create through innovative platforms and tools that unleash creativity, productivity and personalized customer experiences. Adobe’s industry\-leading offerings including Adobe Acrobat Studio, Adobe Express, Adobe Firefly, Creative Cloud, Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Manager, and GenStudio enable people and businesses to turn ideas into impact, powered by AI and driven by human ingenuity.
   

  

 Our 30,000\+ employees worldwide are creating the future and raising the bar as we drive the next decade of growth. We’re on a mission to hire the very best and believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. At Adobe, we believe that great ideas can come from anywhere in the organization. The next big idea could be yours.
   

  

**Let’s Adobe together**
 At Adobe, we believe in creating a company culture where all employees are empowered to make an impact. Learn more about Adobe life, including our values and culture, focus on people, purpose and community, Adobe for All, comprehensive benefits programs, the stories we tell, the customers we serve, and how you can help us advance our mission of empowering everyone to create.
   

  

 Adobe is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on gender, race or color, ethnicity or national origin, age, disability, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Learn more.
   

  

 Adobe aims to make our Careers website and recruiting process accessible to any and all users. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation to navigate our website or complete the application process, email accommodations@adobe.com.
   

  

**AI Use Guidelines for Interviews:**
 Our interviews are designed to reflect your own skills and thinking. If these tools are used inappropriately or in a way that misrepresents your work, your application may not move forward in the process.

title: Copilot Engineer
description:

**Role: Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio**
**Position Summary**
 EY’s GDS Assurance Digital team designs and deploys AI‑enabled solutions that transform audit and assurance workflows at scale. As a
 **Prompt Engineer – Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio** 
 , you will be responsible for designing, engineering, testing, and governing high‑quality prompts, agents, and conversational workflows that power Microsoft Copilot–based solutions for Assurance professionals.
   

  

 This role sits at the intersection of
 **Assurance domain knowledge, Generative AI behaviour, and Microsoft Copilot platform engineering** 
 . You will ensure Copilot solutions are
 **accurate, explainable, safe, compliant, and engagement‑ready** 
 , while delivering measurable productivity and quality outcomes for audit teams.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Prompt Engineering \& AI Behaviour Design**
* Design, refine, and optimize prompts for Microsoft Copilot and Copilot Studio to support audit, controls, risk, and reporting use cases.
* Engineer multi‑turn conversational flows, system prompts, grounding instructions, and response constraints aligned to Assurance methodology.
* Apply prompt patterns such as role‑based prompting, chain‑of‑thought structuring, guardrails, and retrieval‑augmented generation (RAG).
* Continuously test and improve prompt performance for accuracy, consistency, explainability, and hallucination reduction.


**Microsoft Copilot \& Copilot Studio Engineering**
* Build and configure Copilot Studio agents including topics, triggers, entities, actions, plugins, and orchestration logic.
* Integrate Copilot Studio with enterprise data sources, workflows, APIs, and assurance tools in line with security and governance standards.
* Design agent routing and orchestration logic to support multi‑agent or domain‑specific Copilot experiences.
* Collaborate with platform and engineering teams to align Copilot implementations with Microsoft and EY architectural standards.


**AI Quality, Risk \& Governance**
* Define and execute AI testing strategies including prompt validation, negative testing, edge‑case handling, and output evaluation.
* Ensure Copilot solutions meet AI governance, risk management, and compliance expectations (e.g., explainability, traceability, human‑in‑the‑loop).
* Support AI certification, QRM reviews, and engagement‑readiness assessments for Copilot‑based solutions.
* Document prompt logic, assumptions, limitations, and usage guidance for audit and risk review purposes.


**Adoption, Change \& Enablement**
* Support rollout of Copilot solutions through user guidance, prompt playbooks, and best‑practice documentation.
* Train Assurance users on effective Copilot interaction and responsible usage.
* Gather user feedback and usage insights to iteratively improve prompt effectiveness and agent design.


**Research \& Continuous Improvement**
* Stay current on Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure OpenAI, and emerging prompt engineering techniques.
* Evaluate new Copilot features and GenAI capabilities for applicability to Assurance use cases.
* Contribute to reusable prompt libraries, agent templates, and design standards across the Assurance Digital portfolio.


**Required Experience \& Skills**
* 4–7 years of experience in AI‑enabled product, automation, or digital roles.
* Hands‑on experience with prompt engineering for LLM‑based systems.
* Practical experience building solutions using Microsoft Copilot and/or Copilot Studio, Python, LangGraph.
* Strong understanding of LLM behaviour, limitations, risks, and evaluation techniques.
* Ability to translate complex business or regulatory requirements into structured AI interactions.
* Experience working in Agile delivery models with cross‑functional global teams.
* Excellent communication skills; ability to explain AI behaviour to non‑technical stakeholders.


**Preferred / Additional Capabilities**
* Familiarity with Assurance, Audit, Risk, or Regulatory workflows.
* Experience with RAG patterns, vector search, and enterprise data grounding.
* Exposure to AI governance, risk management, or model validation frameworks.
* Knowledge of Azure services and API‑based integrations.
* Ability to create conversation flows, prompt maps, and AI interaction diagrams.


**What Success Looks Like**
* Copilot solutions that deliver trusted, high‑quality, audit‑ready outputs.
* Prompts and agents that are reusable, scalable, and compliant by design.
* Strong adoption and positive feedback from Assurance practitioners.
* Reduced rework, improved efficiency, and enhanced audit quality through AI assistance.


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Smart Metering Solution Architect
description:
**DIRECTOR OF TECHNICAL SOLUTIONS, INTERNATIONAL AMI** 




**Location \-Noida** 




 Experience \-10\+ Years
 



**Employment** 
 Full\-time, permanent
 



**Mandate split** 




 \~40% customer\-facing (pre\-sale technical, discovery, demo, PoC)
 



 \~40% product\-facing (market requirements to product management team)
 



 \~20% market intelligence \& technology landscape
 



  





**What This Role Is Not** 




**This role is not a post\-sale deployment engineer. Once a contract is signed and hardware is shipped, delivery coordination moves to the Regional Delivery Manager.** 




**This role is not a pure pre\-sales role with a quota. You are measured on the quality of technical pipeline built and the quality of product requirements delivered back to product management team.** 




**This role is not a product owner. You surface requirements; the product leadership team makes the call.** 




  





**What We Are Looking For** 




**Essential** 



* 8–12 years of technical experience in smart metering, AMI, or energy technology — either at a meter OEM, system integrator, or utility/metering coordinator on the buyer side
* Deep working knowledge of at least one major certification or technical framework in smart metering— not theoretical familiarity but hands\-on experience with what the process actually requires
* Fluency in the technical language of AMI: DLMS/COSEM, HES/MDMS architecture, communications protocols (RF mesh, NB\-IoT, PLC, LTE\-M), meter accuracy classes, power quality measurement
* Cyber awareness — you understand secure communications in AMI, firmware integrity, key management, and at least one regulatory cybersecurity framework relevant to critical infrastructure or smart metering. You can hold a credible conversation with a utility's security team
* Ability to run a technical discovery conversation with a utility engineer— understand their architecture, identify gaps, and propose a technically credible solution
* Ability to write a technical requirements document that a product owner can work on
* Comfortable operating across cultures and time zones— the product management team is in India/SG, customers are across APAC and Europe
* Strong written and verbal communication — you translate between two technical worlds and both sides need to trust your accuracy



  





**Highly Desirable** 



* Experience with national type approval processes for smart meters— having been through a certification filing, even as a second engineer on the project
* Familiarity with SMETS2specification and DCC connectivity
* Experience with edge intelligence on embedded software platforms (e.g. Zephyr)
* Hands\-on experience with cybersecurity in critical infrastructure or smart metering— secure OTA, PKI, certificate lifecycle management, regulatory audit preparation
* Knowledge of HES/MDMS integration
* Exposure to ADB/World Bank\-funded AMI procurement — understanding of procurement compliance requirements for development\-bank\-funded tenders
* Mandarin or Bahasa useful but not required



  





**The Role** 




 This role has a dual mandate. You are the person who determines whether product can actually win in a specific market — and then ensures the product management teams receive clear, actionable change requests so they know exactly what needs to evolve.
 



  





**Customer\-facing(40% of the role)** 



* Run technical discovery with utility engineers, metering coordinators, and technical procurement leads



 — understand their needs for HES architecture, DLMS/COSEM requirements, communications network, billing data flows, and certification constraints
 


* Build the technical case for value proposition — translate KEI™,KMesh™ into language that a utility engineer or technical head understands and trusts
* Own the technical pre\-sale process: architecture workshops, reference calls, proof\-of\-concept scoping, demo execution
* Support RFP and tender responses on technical sections— accuracy class, communication protocol, cybersecurity posture, data format compliance by working with the product management team
* Hold credible conversations with utility CISOs and security teams on AMI cybersecurity requirements
* Build credibility with technical stakeholders — you are the reason a utility trusts product before the first meter is shipped
* Travel across international markets for key technical engagements — this is not a desk role
* Events and thought leadership
 
 \- Represent at technical industry forums, standards working groups, and utility engineering events as the company's subject matter expert — contributing peer\-to\- peer to the technical conversation, not leading with a commercial agenda. This includes regulatory working groups, metering and grid\-edge conferences, and customer\-hosted technical workshops.



  





**Product\-facing(40% of the role)** 



* Be translation layer between international markets and the product management teams in India/Singapore, capturing differing voltage profiles, data formats, cybersecurity obligations, and DER environments
* Identify certification and regulatory cybersecurity requirements for each target market and feed them into the Market Requirements Document (MRD)
* Deliver structured, prioritized Market Requirements Documents (MRDs) to the CPO and CTO – specific and actionable
* Participate in certification reviews and flag technical blockers before they become commercial risks
* Inform pricing and commercial decisions where current specifications fall short of market technical complexity



  





**Market intelligence and technology landscape(20%)** 




  




* Engage the market, track the technology landscape relevant to markets— where the market is heading. This includes: emerging standards and regulatory changes (new accuracy class requirements, updated cybersecurity mandates, DER integration rules) before they become public procurement criteria; competitor product developments; adjacent technologies gaining traction(BESS sub\-metering, EV charging infrastructure metering, data centre power monitoring); and shifts in utility procurement behaviour (what is moving from CAPEX to OPEX models, what financing structures are gaining traction via ADB/World Bank/JICA).
* Maintain a working view of TAM and SAM for product categories in each active market — not a financial model but a living sense of the addressable opportunity, how it is shifting (new mandates, new utility procurement cycles, competitor wins and losses), and where is under\- or over\- indexed relative to the opportunity. Flag material changes to the International President as they emerge rather than waiting for a quarterly review cycle



  





**Technical Context** 




 You need to understand — or be able to quickly learn — the technical requirements of the markets is entering across APAC and Europe:
 


* AMI standards: DLMS/COSEM protocol stack, IEC 62052/62053 accuracy classes, NEM12/NEM13 data formats, OBIS codes, HES/MDMS integration architecture
* Communications: RF mesh, NB\-IoT, LTE\-M, PLC — how each performs in different grid environments and what utilities prefer
* Certification frameworks: National type approval processes, EU MID/CE marking, SMETS2 specification — at least one in depth, others at working knowledge level
* Edge intelligence: Software\-defined meter platforms, OTA firmware update architecture, edge application deployment — specifically relevant to EI
* Cybersecurity: Secure communications in AMI (DLMS/COSEM encryption, TLS, certificate management, secure boot, OTA signing, key management), regulatory frameworks (SOCI Act, NIS2, NIST CSF, BSI SMGW security requirements), responding to utility CISO questionnaires, understanding data sovereignty and localization requirements
* DER environment: How high solar penetration, VPPs, dynamic tariffs, and BESS integration change what a utility needs from its metering infrastructure



  





**The Person** 



* You are genuinely technical and comfortable reading a DLMS/COSEM standard document or a cybersecurity framework, not just talking about them in abstract terms
* Communicate across personas— from ‘C’ level to the operator
* Commercially aware — able to translate technical solution to what will sell
* Structured thinker — your product feedback is specific, documented, and prioritized.
* Comfortable with ambiguity— you are joining a 0\-to\-1 international build.
* Comfortable to be boundaryless

title: Leadership Role AI Development
description:
**Who We Are**
 Escalent is an award\-winning data analytics and advisory firm that helps clients understand human and market behaviors to navigate disruption. As catalysts of progress for more than 40 years, our strategies guide the world’s leading brands. We accelerate growth by creating a seamless flow between primary, secondary, syndicated, and internal business data, providing consulting and advisory services from insights through implementation. Based on a profound understanding of what drives human beings and markets, we identify actions that build brands, enhance customer experiences, inspire product innovation and boost business productivity. We listen, learn, question, discover, innovate, and deliver—for each other and our clients—to make the world work better for people.
   

  

 Why Escalent? Once you join our team you will have the opportunity to...
   

  

* Access experts across industries for maximum learning opportunities including Weekly Knowledge Sharing Sessions, LinkedIn Learning, and more.
* Gain exposure to a rich variety of research techniques from knowledgeable professionals.
* Enjoy a remote first/hybrid work environment with a flexible schedule.
* Obtain insights into the needs and challenges of your clients—to learn how the world’s leading brands use research.
* Experience peace of mind working for a company with a commitment to conducting research ethically.
* Build lasting relationships with fun colleagues in a culture that values each person.


**Role Overview**
 As Vice President of Software Engineering, you will lead the engineering strategy, architecture, and delivery of Escalent’s SaaS products. You will be responsible for building scalable, secure, cloud\-native applications while accelerating the adoption of Generative AI and intelligent agents across our product portfolio.
   

  

 This is a highly strategic leadership role that combines modern software engineering with AI innovation. You’ll partner closely with Product, AI \& Innovation, UX, Infrastructure and Business Leaders to create differentiated products that delight clients and transform the way research is conducted.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead multiple software engineering teams responsible for the design, development and delivery of Escalent’s SaaS applications.
* Define and execute the engineering strategy supporting our next generation of AI\-enabled products.
* Embed Generative AI, intelligent agents, automation, and conversational experiences into our product ecosystem.
* Drive modern engineering practices including cloud\-native architecture, API\-first development, CI/CD, DevSecOps, automated testing and observability.
* Partner closely with Product Management to deliver high\-quality customer\-centric releases.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, innovation, accountability, and continuous improvement.
* Build and mentor high\-performing engineering leaders and teams across multiple geographies.
* Ensure platform scalability, security, reliability and operational excellence.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and translate them into practical business capabilities.
* Work closely with the executive leadership team to align technology investments with business strategy.


**Required Skills**
* 15\+ years of software engineering experience, including leadership of large engineering organizations.
* Proven experience building and scaling enterprise SaaS platforms.
* Deep expertise in cloud\-native application development.
* Strong understanding of modern software architecture, APIs, distributed systems and microservices.
* Demonstrated experience incorporating Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, or machine learning into software products.
* Experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams.
* Strong executive communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Passion for developing engineering talent and creating high\-performing teams.


**Preferred Experience**
* Experience building AI\-powered SaaS products.
* Familiarity with modern AI frameworks, agentic architectures, MCP, RAG, vector databases and LLM orchestration.
* Experience within research, analytics, data, or information services organizations.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks, cloud data platforms, and event\-driven architectures.


 Explore our Careers and Culture page to learn more about the people behind the brand: https://escalent.co/careers\-and\-culture/

title: Director, Software Development
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti\-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
   

  

 We are seeking an accomplished
 **Software Development Director** 
 to join the OneSpan India Software group in Noida. The ideal candidate brings extensive experience leading enterprise software product and cloud engineering teams, with a strong track record of delivering products using agile methodologies. He / She should have experience managing teams of 20\-40 engineers and be passionate about building high\-quality software products in fast\-paced, AI First and evolving environments. The right candidate should be passionate about software and technology product development, excellent communicator, comfortable with ambiguous environments, and can move fast, bring people and technology together.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Software Development Director is responsible for co\-developing the vision and leading software product development teams in a specific site. He/she develops and communicates the strategic direction for the software teams He/she has final accountability for the delivery, the performance \& the people leadership of the different squads. He/she works closely with various teams to maximize engagement and defines skill growth and location strategies
   

  

**Specific Details About The Role Are As Follows**
* Lead engineering teams responsible for the OneSpan Cyber Security Suite and cloud services deployed on AWS.
* Collaborate with Product Owners, Architects, and DevOps leaders across global teams to define and adopt scalable architectures, engineering standards, and best practices.
* Own software delivery, execution, quality, and engineering effectiveness.
* Provide leadership that drives collaboration, innovation, and organizational growth.


**Key Responsibilities**
 Thought Leadership:
   

  

* Identify emerging technology trends and assess their impact on the business.
* Contribute to technology strategy and prioritize engineering initiatives aligned with business goals.
* Establish and promote engineering methodologies, standards, and best practices.


**People Leadership**
* Develop engineering talent and foster high\-performing, engaged teams.
* Build organizational capabilities aligned with future business and technology needs.
* Support people processes including performance management, talent development, onboarding, and workforce planning.


**Results Leadership**
* Deliver product features and releases efficiently while maintaining quality and scalability.
* Drive accountability for engineering outcomes with an AI\-first mindset and adoption of AI\-assisted development practices.


**About The Successful Candidate**
 The successful candidate is a self\-motivated leader who can deal with complex problems, has a vision to take the organization to the next level. He/She should be able to understand complex security domain including key protocols in identity management and authentication. The candidate must be experienced in developing applications as well and should be able to understand the complexities of software development for on\-premise products and cloud services.
   

  

**Preferred Skills And Experience**
 We are seeking experience with the following technologies/domains:
   

  

* B.S/M.S. in Computer Science, Software Engineering or related technical discipline
* At least 15\-20 years of experience in building Enterprise software products and Cloud Services out of which last 5\-7 years in Software Development Manager responsibilities.
* Prior experience in Leading product and cloud technology teams across diverse technology stack on C\+\+/Node.js/Java preferably Multi\-tenant SaaS/PaaS Services using microservices architecture on any of the cloud environments AWS/Azure/Oracle Public Cloud.
* Must be familiar with containers technologies and ideally should be exposed to any of the full stack technology stack.
* Should have high emotional quotient, self\-driven and shows technology leadership in complex and ambiguous situations.

title: TC-CS-IAM-SailPoint-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY\-Cyber Security\-IAM\- SailPoint IIQ senior**
 At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
   

  

 We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
   

  

 Join EY and help to build a better working world.
   

  

**About Global Delivery Services**
 Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
   

  

 Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000\+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
   

  

 Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy \& Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high\-quality, value\-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
   

  

 Enablement Services provides cost\-effective, high\-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
   

  

 Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 We’re looking for consultants in the cyber security team to work on various Identity and Access Management projects for our customers across the globe. Also, the professional shall need to report any identified risks within engagements and share any issues and updates with the leadership/management on a timely basis
   

  

 In line with EY’s commitment to quality, you’ll confirm that work is of the highest quality as per EY’s quality standards and is reviewed by the next\-level reviewer. As an influential member of the team, you’ll help to create a positive learning culture, coach and counsel junior team members and help them to develop.
   

  

 As a member of the Identity and Access Management (IAM) team this position will contribute towards execution of an IAM roadmap that meets security requirements, implementation and adoption of secrets management, management of machine identities and definition of access policies that meet their needs and are in line with overall IAM Program.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* 3\-7 years of experience in designing and deploying IIQ\-based Identity Governance and Administration solutions
* Ability to drive IGA projects including project management, team management, client management.
* Should have experience in implementing at least one complete IAM SDLC engagements projects. This must include activities such as requirements gathering, analysis, design, development, testing, deployment and application support
* Must have experience in SailPoint IIQ \& IDN architecture, design, development, configuration, testing, integration, and deployment.
* Must have experience in source/ Identity profile configuration, transform/rule development, workflow configuration, JML process and certification, Password sync.
* Must have experience in onboarding AD, JDBC and web service applications to IIQ/IDN
* Must have experience in deployment of virtual appliance, understanding different VA architecture, deploy rules in cloud/VA, High availability/DR configuration
* Configuration and deployment of IQService in cloud and on\-prem environments
* Must have hands on experience in configuring quick link, custom work flow, reports, developing service account management modules, integration with other tools like Service Now, CyberArk etc and plugin development
* IIQ Installation, set up and initial configuration/ upgradation to different versions of IIQ, Standard service build set up and configuration
* Professional IT certifications are a plus.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.


**What We Offer You**
 At EY, we’ll develop you with future\-focused skills and equip you with world\-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams. Learn more.
   

  

 Are you ready to shape your future with confidence? Apply today.
   

  

 To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability\-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
   

  

**Our Commitment** 
 : As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
   

  

**Professional Development** 
 : From entry\-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
   

  

**People and Culture** 
 : In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting\-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
   

  

**How to Apply** 
 : If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user\-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
   

  

 Successful candidates advance to a competency\-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
   

  

 “We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity \& Inclusion”.
   

  

**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Presales AI Solution Architect
description:
**Job Title– Presales AI Solution Architect / SME** 




  





**Role: Senior Presales AI Solution Engineer** 




**Experience: 10\+ Years** 




  





**Role Summary:** 




 We are looking for a technically strong Presales AI Solution Engineer who can independently lead technical solutioning and RFP/RFI responses for AI, Generative AI, Agentic AI and Data/ML opportunities.
 



 The candidate will work closely with Sales, Engineering, Delivery and Product teams to understand customer requirements and convert them into scalable, secure and commercially viable AI solution architectures.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Own end\-to\-end technical response for AI/GenAI RFPs, RFIs and customer proposals.
* Analyze RFP requirements and prepare technical solution architecture, compliance matrix, assumptions, dependencies and technical response documentation.
* Design enterprise AI solutions covering LLMs, RAG, AI Agents, Agentic workflows, MCP, ML/MLOps and data platforms.
* Define solution architecture across AWS, Azure and GCP AI services.
* Recommend appropriate LLMs, embedding models, vector databases, orchestration frameworks and AI infrastructure.
* Design secure enterprise architectures covering RBAC, IAM, encryption, API security, multi\-tenancy, data privacy and governance.
* Prepare architecture diagrams, technology stack, sizing, effort estimation, resource plan, BOM and implementation roadmap.
* Define AI PoCs/MVPs and support customer workshops, technical presentations and solution defense sessions.
* Work with delivery teams to validate solution feasibility, estimation and implementation approach.
* Identify reusable AI accelerators, frameworks and reference architectures to improve RFP response speed and win probability.



  





**Required Technical Expertise** 




  





 Strong hands\-on/architectural knowledge of:
 


* Generative AI \& LLMs: OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, Llama and open\-source models
* Agentic AI: AI Agents, multi\-agent systems, tool calling, MCP, CrewAI, LangGraph/LangChain or equivalent frameworks
* RAG: embeddings, vector search, chunking, reranking, hybrid search and enterprise knowledge integration
* AI/ML: ML lifecycle, model training, inference, evaluation and MLOps
* Data: data engineering, data lakes/lakehouses, structured/unstructured data and ETL/ELT
* Vector Databases: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, Elasticsearch/OpenSearch or equivalent
* Cloud: AWS Bedrock/SageMaker, Azure OpenAI/AI Foundry and GCP Vertex AI
* Architecture: APIs, microservices, event\-driven architecture, Docker and Kubernetes
* Security: IAM, RBAC, OAuth/OIDC, secrets management, encryption, audit logging and AI governance
* Observability: monitoring, tracing, prompt/model monitoring and LLMOps
* Exposure to Computer Vision, Synthetic Data, Robotics or Physical AI will be an advantage.



 Presales Skills
 


* Strong experience responding to enterprise RFPs/RFIs.
* Ability to convert business requirements into detailed technical architectures.
* Strong technical proposal and solution\-document writing skills.
* Experience preparing solution diagrams, effort estimates, implementation plans and technical presentations.
* Strong customer\-facing communication and solution\-defense capabilities.
* Ability to work under aggressive RFP timelines and independently drive technical closure.



 Preferred Profile
 


* Previous experience as AI Solution Architect, GenAI Architect, Presales Architect or AI Technical SME.
* Experience supporting large enterprise or global customer pursuits.
* Good understanding of AI commercial models, cloud costing and solution estimation.
* Relevant AWS/Azure/GCP or AI/ML certifications would be preferred.



 Primary Objective: Build technically differentiated, secure and implementable AI solutions that strengthen our RFP responses and improve overall deal conversion.
